t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Gnomes match with baskets and are corresponding. You should watch out for basket colours and match to the gnomes. If you have a streak of picking a single colour with high mushroom numbers and the numbers suddenly drop, then switch to the other colour

vb_textbox.text: There are 6 different coloured gnomes and these correspond with the two basket colours, red and yellow. If you figure out which colours go with which basket you will earn more points.
